answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 79 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an oasis bet on surviving 79 epochs of grading, and every wharf settlement recomputes the ferrous schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
